name: ergo sum
source:
For a moment, the world broke open – limitless and strange. But reality closed in fast. Rue, a jaded scientist, still clings to old dreams and silent love for Almond.

[From [url=https://scumgirl.itch.io/ergo-sum]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有那麼一刻，世界豁然裂開，顯露出無邊無際的奇異天地。可現實很快又緊逼而來。心灰意冷的科學家露仍抓著舊日的夢想不放，也始終默默愛著阿爾蒙德。
